desc: Betty Crocker Favorites Super Moist Chocolate Fudge Cake makes a rich, dense and sinfully delicious dessert for any occasion. Ready to bake in minutes, this chocolate cake can be topped with your favorite frosting, fruit, or even sprinkles to create a unique treat for your unique needs. Or you can mix it up with one of Betty Crocker's many dessert recipes. With the perfect balance of decadent flavor and convenience, this fudge cake can help you celebrate birthdays, holidays, or Tuesdays. For more than a century, Betty Crocker has been a popular creator of easy, delicious recipes. Today, the Betty Crocker kitchen is still providing convenient, tasty dessert mixes, frostings, and convenient meal options and side dishes.
features:
• Rich Chocolate Fudge Flavor – Delivers a decadent, crowd‑pleasing chocolate fudge taste perfect for holidays or everyday treats 
  • Quick & Convenient – Just add water, oil & eggs for a cake that goes from bowl to oven in minutes 
  • Consistently Moist & Spongy – Produces a soft, tender crumb that stays moist and fluffy for longer
  • Versatile Use – Excellent base for layered cakes, chocolate pudding poke cakes, cupcakes, or cake pops 
  • Trusted Baking Quality – From a century‑old Betty Crocker brand, ensuring reliable results and flavor
ingredients: Enriched Flour Bleached (wheat flour, niacin, iron, thiamin mononitrate, riboflavin, folic acid), Sugar, Corn Syrup, Cocoa Processed with Alkali, Leavening (baking soda, monocalcium phosphate, sodium aluminum phosphate). Contains 2% or less of: Modified Corn Starch, Palm Oil, Corn Starch, Propylene Glycol Mono and Diesters, Monoglycerides, Salt, Dicalcium Phosphate, Sodium Stearoyl Lactylate, Xanthan Gum, Cellulose Gum, Carob Powder, Artificial Flavor.
